left join MODEL_BASE published_model on published_model.ID = case when mb.PARENT_ID is null or mb.PARENT_ID = 0 then mb.ID else mb.PARENT_ID end and published_model.DEL_FLAG = '0' left join MODEL_INSTANCE published_instance on published_instance.ID = published_model.PUBLISHED_INSTANCE_ID and published_instance.MODEL_ID = published_model.ID and published_instance.STATUS = 'SUCCEEDED' left join MODEL_VERSION rv on rv.ID = published_instance.MODEL_VERSION_ID and rv.MODEL_ID = published_model.ID and rv.DEL_FLAG = '0'
